publishCommitRule: The commit published is the main commit that publish-nuget.yml is dispatched at (github.sha). scripts/verify_maintainer_override.py requires that commit to be on fetched protected main, to contain this file, to contain the terminal record below with the recorded sha256, and to declare <Version>0.24.0</Version> in Directory.Build.props. Every later surface binds to the v0.24.0 tag that the publish job creates at that commit.
authorization: I authorize changing the release gate
statement: Calor 0.24.0 is released as an explicit maintainer override outside the #1410 adjudication gate. This release is ungated: the #1408 terminal record is MILESTONE-FAILED, no successful adjudication identity exists, and the record stays unchanged. The override changes neither the record's outcome nor any of its rows.
